note: Which Noita material a Descent cell stands for, when several share one element: an src/appearance.js label carried in the cell's unused ctype (VARIANT_* only on non-conducting ROCK/SANDSTONE/NOITA_TEMPLE; WOOD reuses its LOG labels, PLANKS its PLANK labels). The Noita view (src/shaders/gfx/noita.js NOITA_ELEMENT_LOOKS) draws each label. Unlisted native materials take their element's default look. tools/check-noita-materials.mjs checks every entry.
